title: Japan in Winter
subtitle: Tokyo lights, Mt Fuji views & slow days in Kyoto

activities.name: Land at Haneda Airport
activities.note: Get a Suica card at the station and top up ¥5,000.

activities.name: Senso-ji Temple
activities.note: Walk Nakamise street for snacks. Try ningyo-yaki cakes.

activities.name: Tokyo Skytree at sunset
activities.note: Book a time slot online. On clear days you can see Mt Fuji.

activities.name: Yakitori at Omoide Yokocho
activities.note: Tiny smoky alley bars. Bring cash.

activities.name: Highway bus to Kawaguchiko
activities.note: About 2 hours. Sit on the left for Fuji views.

activities.name: Chureito Pagoda
activities.note: 398 steps up — the classic pagoda + Fuji photo.

activities.name: The famous Fuji convenience store
activities.note: Grab onigiri and hot milk tea. Please be quick & polite with photos.

activities.name: Hoto noodle dinner
activities.note: Thick noodles in miso pumpkin stew — perfect for winter.

activities.name: Ryokan with onsen
activities.note: Ask for a room with a Fuji view.

activities.name: Shinkansen to Kyoto
activities.note: Bus to Mishima, then Hikari to Kyoto (~2h).

activities.name: Fushimi Inari Shrine
activities.note: Thousands of torii gates. Go up to Yotsutsuji viewpoint.

activities.name: Nishiki Market lunch crawl
activities.note: Tamagoyaki, soy milk donuts, matcha everything.

activities.name: Fly home from Kansai
activities.note: Haruka express from Kyoto Station (~75 min).

tips: Carry some cash — small shops and alley bars often don't take cards.
Winter is cold but clear: best season for Mt Fuji views.
Book Skytree and the ryokan early; December fills up fast.
Comfy shoes! You'll walk 15,000+ steps a day.
